但是在特朗普宣布保护油轮之后

yesterday was my last day with @yzilabs (formerly @BinanceLabs). reflecting on nearly 4 years, I am deeply grateful for the journey. looking back, there are four highlights that I will carry with me:

1/ it has been a privilege to work closely with and learn from our LPs @cz_binance @heyibinance. thank you for the trust, the mentorship and the opportunity.

2/ to the founders who let me into your journeys (in chronological order):
- in 2023, @tn_pendle (@pendle_fi), @gdog97_ (@ethena)
- in 2024, @0xpengyu (@ParticleNtwrk), @no89thkey (@brevis_zk), @annakaz & @artieart88 (@vana), @realyanxin (@Sign), @HanyangWang (@Funes_World)
- in 2025, @ohyishi (@OneKeyHQ), @0xZergs (@USDai_Official), @BlockRazor_Inc, @thecryptoskanda & @heroyangv (@Hertzflow_xyz), the "leos" in crypto @Leozayaat (@42space) @leokeeplearning (@apro), and others I’ve had the honor to support. 

the list is far longer than one post allows, but I’m wishing only the best for all of you.

3/ driving the acquisition of Jackson @0xOar and his team into @BinanceWallet with @Winson_Bit's support. seeing that deal through was a testament to the persistent hard work and the relentless pursuit of excellence in this space.

4/ last but certainly not least, I’m grateful to have worked with super talented, serious and hardworking investors: @cyodyssey, @p2fp2e, @mc_9393, @The_Babylonians, and @odagius. over the years, many efforts and hearts have been poured into the work. some ventures flourished and some didn’t, yet we either gained or learned. 相信功不唐捐。

I’m equally proud of the talent I brought into the team, including @0xRickyW, @yunna025, and @Hui_Huangg (referral credit to @gizmothegizzer - another wonderful female founder we backed in 2024). with the best intern @cz_binance and with @ellazhang516 leading the team with vision, @yzilabs will only get better.

my conviction in this space remains unchanged:
- btc remains a store of value. 十币称侯 https://t.co/P0yZoPX1rK
- crypto as an asset class is here to stay, rooted in its unique risk/return profile and permissionless nature.
- blockchain as an open, borderless infrastructure will harness more efficient financial rails and provide universal access to on-chain assets and high-throughput, low-cost services.

I’m moving on to new endeavors, but I’ll continue to cheer for everyone from the sidelines.

blockchain doesn’t need permission to be useful and to thrive.

long live crypto.

青山不改，绿水长流，我们后会有期。

ps: 
to all who celebrate - 元宵节快乐，马年越来越好！
